items.question: How fast can we issue the first card?
items.answer: Minutes. Create an account, set a budget, and issue a virtual card against it — nothing to install and no bank paperwork to start.

items.question: What happens when a budget runs out?
items.answer: Cards drawing on it decline politely and the holder sees why. Raising the limit is one edit, with the approval trail kept.

items.question: Does it work with our accounting stack?
items.answer: The ledger exports clean CSV today and the transactions come pre-coded by category, member, and card — your accountant maps it once.

items.question: Can I cancel or export my data?
items.answer: Any time, from account settings. Your ledger stays yours and stays exportable.

brand.$comment: No committed logo/logoMark on purpose: the product is black and white, and a baked image can't read on both grounds. BrandMark and the app shell fall back to the theme-aware plate (accent tile + wordmark in text color) — a hard white plate on black in dark mode, the negative in light — which IS the monolith identity. icon/social stay baked for favicons and og:image.
